race.comment: LEONARDO DA GREY (4) looks the one to beat after closing into third over 1100m at this track and finishing just over two lengths from Champeze in BM58+ company at the run prior. He is proven at this track and distance, with one win and three places from four attempts, and that gives him the strongest overall profile among the main chances. AMARLIE MISS (10) is a genuine danger after charging home for third behind Noble Touch, despite being hampered late, and her record of three placings from four starts at this track and distance keeps her right in calculations. ARCHENEMY (1) has been around the mark in both runs at this venue, was fourth last start after working home from well back, and the 3kg claim helps offset the weight. TRULY GALLANT (3) was below market expectations as favourite in a BM58+ last start but this presents as a good opportunity to bounce back. BESTON STREET (5) can feature in the finish.
